rank_definition.rank_unit: Within each historical observation and action group, among layers 1..17
rank_definition.aggregation: Mean layer rank over five task observations and three action groups within each suite; mask score is sum over six skipped layers
rank_definition.proposal_objective: Equal mean of jacobian and action_mse mask rank scores within each suite

constraints.mutation: Restore exactly one anchor-skipped layer and skip exactly one previously retained layer

proposal_rule: Select the lowest-scoring nonprevious neighbor for each suite using archived calibration only; no closed-loop result or new initial state is used

proposed_experiment_scope.conditions: Four proposed neighbors plus Jac anchor plus Full
proposed_experiment_scope.confirmation_qualification_rule: Not specified here; root must freeze a separate rule before discovery

limitations: Layer metrics come from historical Full-trajectory single-layer perturbations, not six-layer compensated-path outcomes.
proposal_suite labels the calibration source of the proposal; it is not an observed task preference or a confirmatory direction.
